name: com.getmcpads/x-ads
title: X Ads
description: X Ads MCP server: 25 read tools, 19 opt-in preview-first writes.

environmentVariables.name: X_ADS_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: User OAuth 2.0 token. Keep it secret.

environmentVariables.name: X_ADS_ACCOUNT_IDS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated allowed account IDs. Required even for reads.

environmentVariables.name: X_ADS_SCOPES
environmentVariables.description: Scopes actually granted to the token, including ads.read.

environmentVariables.name: X_ADS_ENABLE_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: true enables write tools. Defaults to false.
